svg.title: Azure End-to-End Data Lakehouse project card
svg.desc: Architecture diagram showing a three-layer lakehouse: bronze ingestion via ADF, silver transformation via Databricks and PySpark, gold serving via Synapse, all on ADLS Gen2 with Delta Lake.
